title: RAW UNREVIEWED: transferred drawing subassemblies test object-bound versus page-bound label identity
summary: RAW_UNREVIEWED_NOT_SELECTED_NOT_TESTED. A demonstrably transferred or recopied drawing subassembly may retain an attached complete label when placed in a different orientation or page position. Freeze subassembly correspondence from physical construction traces or rare attached anomalies without text, then test whether label ownership travels with that component or remains tied to a page slot. No copied pair or chronology is assumed.

design.mechanism: The maker relocates a reusable pictured component while retaining either its object name/code or a separate layout instruction attached to a page coordinate.
design.unit: Complete illustrated entries containing independently bound matching subassemblies and explicitly owned labels on different physical leaves.
design.contrast: Object-bound label identity versus page-position instruction, broad visual class label, and independent semantic reuse without common manufacture.
design.prediction: When the same bound component changes page coordinate and orientation, the complete label follows the component under an object-bound account; a page-bound account instead predicts the stable coordinate. At least two conflicting destinations are needed, not one isolated resemblance.
design.scope: RAW proposal only, no data opened or capacity asserted. IDEA739 external named copying-anomaly owner remains unbound; this asks internal label attachment under demonstrable relocation without assigning a plant name. GDT812 displaced-vessel no-label limitation and GDT796 mirror/facies stop remain retained. Requires new independent manufacturing correspondences and ownership; no arbitrary rotation, shape-only pairing or label-based visual selection. A transported identifier is not yet a translated noun.
